segments.title: 第41章 自我介紹
segments.content:
Rekindling Youth Chapter 41 Self-Introductions

As soon as Kong Junxiang's voice fell, a girl in the first row stood up, walked to the teacher, and took her student card.

Hua Xiuxiu wore a pair of round-framed glasses, her long hair draped over her shoulders. She had a delicate and pretty face, giving off a scholarly air.

Sitting behind Hua Xiuxiu, Lin Yuan stared at her on the stage without blinking, growing nervous for her as she was the first to go up for a self-introduction.

In contrast, Hua Xiuxiu herself looked calm, showing no signs of nervousness.

She took a piece of chalk from the lectern, turned, and wrote the three large characters "Hua Xiuxiu" on the blackboard. Her penmanship was very beautiful.

After writing her name, Hua Xiuxiu turned back to face the class and spoke in a steady, unhurried tone:

"Hello everyone, my name is Hua Xiuxiu. I'm from Yucai Middle School. I'm very happy to meet and get to know all of you here."

"My hobby is reading. My favorite book is 'Jane Eyre' by the British author Charlotte Brontë."

"For the next three years, I hope we can become like-minded friends, learn from each other, and work hard together."

"Thank you, everyone."

Hua Xiuxiu gave a slight bow at the lectern, finished her self-introduction, and walked back to her seat with a composed expression.

The students below applauded one after another. Lin Yuan clapped the most enthusiastically, his applause loud and sharp, which naturally earned him a glance from Hua Xiuxiu.

"Lin Yuan," Kong Junxiang said at the right moment.

"Here!" Lin Yuan stood up reflexively. His entire body tensed up, and he nearly walked toward the teacher with his arm and leg on the same side moving in sync.

After getting his student card, he went on stage and picked up the chalk, only for it to break halfway through writing his name. The stroke went crooked, and Lin Yuan, sweating, quickly wiped it off to rewrite it.

After all that fuss, Lin Yuan's face was a little flushed, but luckily his skin was on the darker side, so it wasn't too noticeable.

After stumbling through his self-introduction, Lin Yuan practically fled back to his seat, finally letting out a sigh of relief.

Kong Junxiang smiled and continued to call the next student to the stage.

"Shao Heqi."

"Zhu Yufei."

"Wei Chun."

"..."

Something like a self-introduction was quite torturous for students who were thin-skinned.

Although each person was only up there for a minute or two, the long wait beforehand was unbearable.

Those who were further down the list, in particular, hardly had the mind to listen to their classmates speak on stage.

They were constantly thinking about what they were going to say when it was their turn, afraid they would forget everything in a moment of nervousness.

Students who brought paper and a pen might have already secretly taken them out to write down what they planned to say, which helped to ease their minds a little.

Li Luo, however, wasn't worried. He figured he would just go up and say a few things casually.

While listening to the cute speeches of his classmates on stage, he silently operated his memory palace, recording everything everyone said.

After exploring it for some time, Li Luo had roughly figured out the effects of this memory palace in his mind.

To put it simply.

For the entire 35 years of memories from his past life, Li Luo had to expend a relatively large amount of mental power and energy to re-download them before he could use them.

As for things he experienced after his rebirth, whether seen or heard, he could retrieve them at any time as needed. They were essentially already downloaded, not requiring much mental power or energy.

To be honest, after figuring out these functions, even if he didn't directly retrieve the exam papers from his past life's Gaokao, he could still get good grades just by studying hard with this ability.

As he was thinking this, Teacher Kong at the door had already called out the next student's name: "Yan Zhusheng."

Her name being called, Yan Zhusheng rose from her seat, walked up to Kong Junxiang, and took her student card.

Then, under the watchful gaze of all her classmates, she walked up to the lectern, picked up a piece of chalk, and wrote her name high up on the blackboard.

Li Luo glanced at the expressions of a few boys in the back row, then shook his head with a silent laugh, thinking that his boss's charm truly couldn't be hidden.

In his previous life, with her looks and singing talent, without manipulated data or clickbait videos, just by simply recording a few lines of lyrics, Yan Zhusheng's Douyin account gained several million followers.

Li Luo had a very direct and comprehensive understanding of Yan Zhusheng's personal appeal, so he wasn't surprised to see the entranced looks on the boys' faces in his class.

"I'm Yan Zhusheng."

"My hobbies are music and running."

"Thank you."

Yan Zhusheng's self-introduction was very brief. After saying three sentences, she walked off the stage.

Before Yan Zhusheng had even made it back to her seat, Li Luo heard Kong Junxiang say, "Li Luo."

It being his turn, Li Luo stood up from his seat, brushed past Yan Zhusheng, and then walked up to Teacher Kong.

"Here you go." Kong Junxiang looked at Li Luo with a smile and handed him the student card.

Li Luo reached out to take it. Then, following the procedure, he wrote his name on the blackboard, turned to face the class, and broke into a smile:

"Hello everyone, I'm Li Luo."

"I'm a bit of a strange person. I don't have any other hobbies, I just like being the class president."

"We'll be classmates for the next three years, so I hope this friendship will be enough for everyone to indulge me in this small hobby of mine."

"Thank you!"

Applause rose from below.

Some students were amused and laughed.

Shao Heqi, sitting in the first row, looked speechless, cursing inwardly that this guy was so damn shameless.

Besides, you brat, you never held any class officer position for all three years of middle school, and now you want to be the class president as soon as you get to high school? That's just too fanciful.

Moreover, the form teacher had just said that after the self-introductions, students who wanted to run for positions could come up to the stage to give a speech.

Shao Heqi really hadn't expected this kid, Li Luo, to be so shameless as to start his campaign right during his self-introduction.

So damn cunning!

And Kong Junxiang, who was sitting by the door, was also a bit taken aback.

When he heard Li Luo say he wanted to be class president earlier, he had thought he was just joking.

He never thought he was being serious.

"Alright, the election will begin now." After handing out all the student cards, Teacher Kong clapped his hands and said with a smile, "We'll elect the class president and vice president at the same time. For the students participating, the two with the highest number of votes will become the class president and vice president."

"As for the sports representative, we'll have one boy and one girl. Both boys and girls can come up to speak."

"So, any interested students may come to the stage to give their campaign speech."

As soon as Kong Junxiang's voice fell, Hua Xiuxiu, in the first row, had already stood up and was walking straight toward the lectern.

Shao Heqi had also intended to get up, but seeing that Hua Xiuxiu was a step faster, he paused for half a beat and had to sit back down to wait.

"Hello everyone, I'm Hua Xiuxiu."

"From elementary school until I graduated from middle school, I served as the class president for a total of nine years, so I have a wealth of experience."

"I believe a class president must first have sufficient ability, not just be someone who makes everyone find them interesting and gets a few laughs."

As she said this, Hua Xiuxiu looked at Li Luo without backing down, clearly alluding to what he had done during his self-introduction.

"If I am elected class president, I will definitely be dedicated and responsible in this role and serve everyone well."

"Thank you."

After Hua Xiuxiu finished her speech, she walked off the stage.

Shao Heqi from the first row immediately followed.

In the back row, Li Luo simply smiled after hearing Hua Xiuxiu's speech, not minding it at all.

On the contrary, Yan Zhusheng, who was beside him, turned her head to look at Li Luo, blinked, and said, "I think she's scolding you."

Li Luo: "...You don't have to be so blunt."
